newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hang Seng sees home mortgage slowdown.
newsitem.headline: Hang Seng sees home mortgage slowdown.

text.p: Hang Seng Bank Ltd said on Tuesday it expects the bank's home mortgage lending to slow down in two to three months due to the recent slowdown in Hong Kong's property market.

Alexander Au, vice-chairman and chief executive, told reporters it would take about two to three months for the recent slowdown in property market to be reflected in the bank's mortgage loans at the drawdown level.
Au stressed the expected slowdown was not a major concern because the property market, with long-term demand, would pick up as soon as prices become affordable once more.
Hong Kong property prices have tumbled some 10 percent from their recent peaks after the government announced measures to curb sharply rising prices in late March.
The bank's mortgage loans have been steady in the past few weeks after the government announced the measures, Au said.
He added short-term adjustment in the property market is healthy.
